Full Stack & DevOps Engineer
Ariana, Tunisia  ·  +216 51 996 304  ·  nassimbenmustpha99@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/nassim-ben-mustapha-817648200
Software Engineer specialized in Full Stack development and DevOps, ranking among the top students of my graduating class at TEK-UP University. Over nearly five years of professional experience, I have contribut to multiple large-scale projects covering backend development, cloud industrialization (CI/CD, monitorin high availability) and end-to-end application lifecycle management. Committed to continuous improvement, I am currently preparing several international certifications (PCAP, OCA, CKA).
Full Stack & DevOps Engineer  ·  XFlowData
-Infrastructure & DevOps: migrated architectures to high-availability cloud environments; built CI/CD pipelines and monitoring stacks (Prometheus / Grafana) to ensure system resilience.
-Data & AI Solutions: designed and developed backend services and AI-powered data extraction tools, from database modeling to production deployment.
-Full Stack Development: designed and implemented complex features (backend & application logic), including Unity modules integrated with cloud workflows.
-Quality  Assurance  &  Automated  Testing: designed  and  industrialized  testing  strategies  (unit, integration,  BDD  and  load  /  performance  testing),  integrated  into  CI/CD  pipelines  to  ensure  delive reliability and prevent regressions.
-Cloud & Deployment: automated application lifecycle via Unity Cloud and managed deployments to app stores.
